en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside pier or landing stage crowded with people in late‑19th / early‑20th century dress. A steam‑powered vessel is moored at the pier, with its tall smokestack visible. In the background is a tree‑lined riverbank. Printed captions in red at the bottom identify the location as Budapest and specifically the Császár baths landing stage (Haltestelle Kaiserbad). Publisher information appears along the lower edge.
